scope: Tesla Charge Companion V9 German CPO first-pass

this_pass.evidence: Official current e-mobility page publishes the public ad-hoc AC tariff from 01.01.2026 at EUR 0.52/kWh, payable by NFC credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and similar contactless methods. The same table separately identifies the discounted customer tariff, so no contract tariff is mixed into ad-hoc.

Official public charging page states that non-SWS electricity customers charge at the Standard-Tarif by spontaneous payment with credit card or PayPal and publishes EUR 0.64/kWh. The page separately lists the MeinSpeyer customer tariff at EUR 0.47/kWh and no start/blocking fee, so the standard spontaneous tariff remains distinguishable.

Official 2025 network publication confirms more than 160 charging points and that all Mainzer Stadtwerke stations support ad-hoc charging by QR code with credit card or PayPal, as well as eCharge+ access. No current 2026 numeric ad-hoc price table was found in the first-pass official search, so no price was inferred from roaming or app-only context.
this_pass.reason: ad-hoc access confirmed; current numeric direct price not publicly established in first pass

this_pass.evidence: Official current charging-card page publishes card tariffs valid from 01.09.2025, including specific SWK/Ladestationen Südwest card prices and time fees, but these are contractual Ladekarte values rather than a proven public ad-hoc/direct tariff. The public e-mobility pages reviewed did not expose a current universal direct-payment tariff for SWK-operated EVSEs.
this_pass.reason: only contractual Ladekarte pricing established; no current universal ad-hoc tariff proven

this_pass.evidence: Official current public-charging pages route users to the EWR Ladekarte/Ladenetz App or e-Charge+ for public charging and describe fixed contract pricing, but the first-pass official search did not surface a numeric ad-hoc/direct-pay tariff for EWR-operated charging stations. No card tariff was promoted to ad-hoc.
this_pass.reason: public charging access confirmed but exact current direct/ad-hoc station tariff not established

coherence.policy: First-pass coverage prioritized. Three unresolved operators were deferred immediately after reasonable official-source investigation; no prior deferred case was re-audited.
coherence.duplicate_check: The five entries in this pass were selected as new identities relative to the latest explicit checkpoint and known prior German research history. No aliases were counted as separate CPOs.
